page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-8x.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with one thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8469C processors running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 12.0 GB of RAM per CPU core.

This server configuration includes eight integrated GPUs with a combined total of 768 GB of VRAM. It does not contain any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the high ratio of VRAM to system memory and the dedicated, non-hyperthreaded CPU cores position this instance in a high-density hardware class. It is designed for workloads requiring massive parallel processing capabilities and substantial memory footprints, such as large-scale machine learning model training, deep learning inference, and complex data science computations.
